description: Send product feedback about Sequenzy itself to the Sequenzy team, for use when the user asks to report feedback. The message is delivered to Sequenzy staff. A report needs only the reproduction details and resource IDs required to investigate; unrelated subscriber data, message content, credentials, raw API payloads, and debug data are not needed. This is not a channel for questions about the user's own account or data. Submitting feedback never changes account data.

category.description: Feedback category. Use missing_capability when the user wanted something these tools do not support, bug when a tool misbehaved or produced a wrong result (default: other).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

context.description: Optional: what the user was trying to accomplish, in their words, plus any relevant tool names or arguments that were tried. Secrets and unrelated personal data are not needed.

message.description: The feedback itself. Be specific: what was needed, what was missing or wrong, and what you did instead (workaround, gave up, used the dashboard).

resourceIds.description: IDs of affected resources so the team can correlate the report with server logs. Include only IDs needed to investigate the reported issue.

toolCalls.description: For bug or wrong-outcome reports: the ordered tool calls that led to the problem. Summarized arguments are sufficient; raw subscriber data, full email bodies, and secrets are not needed.

args.description: Short summary of the arguments used.

error.description: Error message returned by this call, if there was one.

userIntent.description: For bug or wrong-outcome reports: the user's request, verbatim or closely paraphrased. Omit personal data that is not needed to reproduce the problem.

name: submit_feedback

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `submit_feedback` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
